metadata.name: domWallet
metadata.description: (lock, names?) - the unsafe-wallet panel authored as a dom() formula (a showcase that interactive UI can be a formula). Compose it from the wallet's own readers: =domWallet(locked(walletNote), apiKeys()). Locked -> status + an unlock password box (wallet.unlock). Unlocked -> status + a lock button (wallet.lock) + a delete chip per key (wallet.del) + an add-a-key row (name -> wallet.newName, secret -> wallet.setNamed). Wires the SAME wallet.* handlers via on(); no new handlers, no secrets.
